label: Scaling the Newton step
subgoals: Multiply it by the damping factor
Restore the full step once near the root

label: Backtracking until the residual drops
subgoals: Try the full step and evaluate the residual
Halve the step until the residual decreases
Accept the first step that passes the decrease test

label: Limiting the voltage change per iteration
section: Limiting the voltage change per iteration
subgoals: Find the largest proposed node voltage change
Scale the step so it equals the allowed maximum
Apply the scaled update to every node
